
# foreman_webhooktemplate





## Example Usage

```
# Autogenerated example with required keys
resource "foreman_webhooktemplate" "example" {
  name = "compute"
}
```


## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `audit_comment` - (Optional) Comment for audits.
- `default` - (Optional) Whether or not the template is added automatically to new organizations and locations.
- `description` - (Optional) Webhook Template description.
- `location_ids` - (Optional) List of all locations the webhook template can use.
- `locked` - (Optional) Whether or not the template is locked for editing.
- `name` - (Required) Webhook Template name
- `organization_ids` - (Optional) List of all organizations the webhook template can use.
- `snippet` - (Optional) Specifies if webhook template is a snippet.
- `template` - (Required) Content of the webhook template.


## Attributes Reference

The following attributes are exported:

- `audit_comment` - Comment for audits.
- `default` - Whether or not the template is added automatically to new organizations and locations.
- `description` - Webhook Template description.
- `location_ids` - List of all locations the webhook template can use.
- `locked` - Whether or not the template is locked for editing.
- `name` - Webhook Template name
- `organization_ids` - List of all organizations the webhook template can use.
- `snippet` - Specifies if webhook template is a snippet.
- `template` - Content of the webhook template.
